a-frame-house.<b1>Що робили:</b> архітектура A-frame,: Scope: A-frame architecture, interior design, textiles and furniture selection, 3D visualisations
a-frame-house.Треба було спроєктувати будинок A-frame: The task was to design an A-frame holiday house: the volume itself, with its steep gable roof, and an interior where the space under the slopes is comfortable for sleeping, sitting by the fire and looking out.
a-frame-house.Фронтон зробили панорамним, а над віталь: We made the gable end fully glazed and kept a double-height space above the living room, so daylight reaches the full height of the house. The mezzanine hangs over the living room and looks down, and the bedrooms sit under the pitched roof. The heart of the ground floor is a stove-fireplace.
a-frame-house.Для інтерʼєру взяли тепле дерево, мʼякий: The interior uses warm wood, soft textiles and rugs with Ukrainian ornament, while the solid-wood furniture keeps simple shapes. Textiles and furniture were chosen together with the architecture, which is why the house looks lived-in on the visualisations. A house like this can stand on its own or be repeated across a holiday resort.
a-frame-house.Дизайн-проєкт: архітектура A-frame, інте: Design project: A-frame architecture, interior, textiles and furniture selection, 3D visualisations — you can see them in the photos below. We price construction to a design like this after a cost estimate: shell and core from $600/m², turnkey from $1,100/m².
a-frame-house.Будинки для відпочинку CAS будує також к: CAS also builds holiday houses as timber-frame, modular and log houses. The architectural design covers the concept and working stages of the architectural and structural sections; engineering sections are added as required.
